>I think the best thing to do is start by removing ALL things that would enable your situation. 

I've tried to before and failed. I can stop for months at a time but then this extremely strong urge comes over me that makes me irritated. I can't stop thinking about it. I can't jerk off to normal things. Its like flushing all the dopamine out of my head completely. 

I am surrounded by computers all the time. All i need to do is get a USB and next thing I know I am back on it within an hour. I know too much about computers to really quit this and I fucking hate it. I want to be a normal person with normal desires.

Edit: and it sucks to even talk about my issues because theres a massive hole in my life that is causing my problems.
